delta.source: the figure's evasion threshold: a bound holds unless the adversary evades detection with probability above 1%

budgets.source: the figure's curves: the share of the scope's GPU-seconds spent on replays, interior commitments and proofs

overheads.source: the figure's x-axis: proof overhead, proving time over the proved computation's time at the GPU's dense peak

proof_overhead.source: C-Flock --zk on an H200, s8 K=4096 proof blocks in statements of 1,024 and 2,048, warm, against the H200's dense peak (runs r20261105-042916-546a, r20261105-044913-6ff9, r20261105-050310-c09e); provisional until the proof-overhead card is defined

hash_rate.source: SHA-512 hm96 rows on the whole H200 at 4 KiB rows: 5.21e11 B/s measured at 16 KiB rows (r20261027-042422-85b2) at 91.5 B a compression

token_bytes.source: a token id as a u32, as a request's boundary commits it

weights_bytes.source: GLM-5.3's block-FP8 checkpoint at aca966e4 (integrations/vllm/manifests/checkpoints.json, role GLM53: 755.7 GB)
